sentences.text: In this matter, offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 354, 506(ii), 498A and 376 r/w 149 of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC' for short) are alleged to have been committed by the accused.

sentences.text: It is pointed out by the learned counsel for the petitioner that even though offence under Section 376 of IPC also is involved, the victim is none other than the wife of the second accused, the petitioner herein, and the case against all other accused in this matter has been quashed by this Court as per common order dated 20.02.2006 in Crl.M.C.Nos.4155, 4156, 4167 & 4185 of 2005.
